provenance.author: document-harness
provenance.reason: The migrated html corpus carries inline `id` and `class` attributes that Markdown cannot represent, so the declared behavior is a visible refusal rather than a silent drop
provenance.semantic: html inline attributes are refused with notedown.format.unsupported

provenance.author: document-harness
provenance.reason: The html importer keeps the prose, tables, lists and links it can map and reports one loss per element it cannot represent, so form controls, inline style, script and image dimensions are declared instead of aborting the conversion
provenance.semantic: html input converts to markdown with declared losses for unsupported style, form and script elements

provenance.author: document-harness
provenance.reason: The latest pinned document.rs reports raw passthrough for form, script and style instead of the former unsupported_* codes, so the expectation follows the renamed loss codes
provenance.semantic: html input converts to markdown with raw_form, raw_form_control, raw_script and raw_style losses

provenance.author: aster <aster@vers.site> @ 81e1aa2a38735d216cd92824753f7ad3c0c3c903
provenance.reason: The new pin materializes HTML image bytes only when the caller supplies them, so the plain no-bytes conversion now declares asset_unresolved alongside the raw element losses
provenance.semantic: html input converts to markdown with declared losses for unresolved image assets and raw style, form and script elements

provenance.author: aster <aster@vers.site> @ 74366e949afa48bd898ab08b75e0ec4a4ff0a5e1
provenance.reason: Image width and height now survive the HTML import and the markdown writer keeps them on the img tag, so the image_dimensions loss retires and the expectation names only the remaining losses
provenance.semantic: html input converts to markdown with dimensions preserved on the img tag and losses only for unresolved assets, raw style, form and script elements

provenance.author: aster <aster@vers.site> @ 74366e949afa48bd898ab08b75e0ec4a4ff0a5e1
provenance.reason: The importer now warns about the unresolved image asset as well, so the diagnostic set follows the observed codes and drops the retired image_dimensions entry
provenance.semantic: html input converts to markdown with diagnostics for unresolved assets, raw style, form and script elements
